answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 2690 Country: EG Title: I work in a private non-Islamic bank, my job is in the Credit department where we give loans to companies in order to help them in buying new machines & financing their production cycle. All loans are given after thorough studing & analysis to companies' risks & operations, the bank ofcourse receives interest on said loans which is pre-agreed upon in the contracts. My job also involves approaching new companies as to market our loan packages. Is my salary/job permissable or not? Question: I work in a private non-Islamic bank, my job is in the Credit department where we give loans to companies in order to help them in buying new machines & financing their production cycle. All loans are given after thorough studing & analysis to companies' risks & operations, the bank ofcourse receives interest on said loans which is pre-agreed upon in the contracts. My job also involves approaching new companies as to market our loan packages. Is my salary/job permissable or not? Answer ID: 2690 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 46/47=L) It is narrated in Hadith: عن جابر رضی اللہ عنہ قال: لعن رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم آکل الربوا و موکلہ وکاتبہ و شاھدیہ وقال ھو سواء ( مشکوۃ 1/244 ) The Prophet (peace be upon him) accursed one who devours usury, one who feeds it, one who writes it and one who bears witness to it. He added: They all are equal. (Mishkat: 1/244) Therefore, doing a work in bank which involves giving interest-based loan to people is unlawful. But, you are not asked the leave the job immediately, it is advised to look for a lawful job and when find one leave the bank. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
